newsitem.title: UK: Ibstock's Hopkins to leave co immediately.
newsitem.headline: Ibstock's Hopkins to leave co immediately.

text.p: Ibstock Plc, the UK building materials group, said on Thursday that Anthony Hopkins, responsible for the Building Products division, is to leave the company with immediate effect.

The group said his responsibilities will be taken over by Philip Mengel, the chief executive. A spokesman for Ibstock told Reuters that the group was discussing the details of Hopkins' departure but gave no reason for his leaving.

Sir Colin Hope, chairman said in a statement "Following the announcement last week that Philip Mengel will become chief executive we have decided that it is in the company's best interest that he should take direct control of Ibstock's UK and U.S. brick interests."
